{{Quotation|game|
In years past, [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)|Piken Square]] was a bustling market where farmers and merchants would come to hawk their wares. Now its strong bones serve as the last human bastion beyond the [[Great Northern Wall|Northern Wall]].
}}

==Getting there==
Complete the quest [[A Bastion In the North]] first. Alternatively, another player who has completed the quest may [[ferry]] you there.

From Ascalon City, follow the west path until you reach the gate to The Northlands. Pull the lever at the top of the wall to open the gate, then walk through doors below. Follow the path north and stay on the middle path.

==Notes==
{{gw2w|Old Piken Ruins}}
* If any party members have [[Across the Wall]] or [[A Bastion In the North]] active in their [[quest log]], or if no party members have completed A Bastion In the North, the sign and portal leading to the outpost will not be present in the Northlands, even if the party entered from Piken Square.
** Characters who have unlocked the outpost without meeting these requirements can still map travel to the outpost, even if they have opted out of {{reforgedmode}}.
* Piken Square (pre-Searing), [[Brauer Academy]], [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]], [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh (outpost)|Grand Court of Sebelkeh]], [[The Mouth of Torment]], [[Yahnur Market]], [[Sifhalla]], and [[Tarnished Haven]] are the only outposts with two exits leading to the same zone.

==Trivia==
* This is one of the few outposts in the game (alongside [[Chahbek Village (outpost)|Chahbek Village]]) without a [[Merchant]].
* Dialogue in [[Barradin's Advance]] and [[Casualty Report]] describes [[Duke Barradin]] capturing Piken Square in 1072 AE, implying that Lieutenant Greywind abandons the outpost during or after [[the Searing]].
